english.title: Falsify / conceal / destroy / otherwise dispose of a required document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), intentionally

(A)_[falsified]_
(B)_[concealed]_
(C)_[destroyed or otherwise disposed of]_

a document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..), which you had been required by an order under section 20BA of the Taxes Management Act 1970

(D)_[to deliver]_
(E)_[to deliver to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON OR LOCATION..) or make available for inspection]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20BB(1) and (5) of the Taxes Management Act 1970.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
